name: exposes
description: A CLI command exposes the command it runs, as an endpoint exposes its operation. (A product kind has one parent kind, so a CLI command sits under its domain and names its operation by this link and in its ID.)

name: exposes
description: A CLI command exposes the query it runs, as an endpoint exposes its operation. (A product kind has one parent kind, so a CLI command sits under its domain and names its operation by this link and in its ID.)

name: measured_by
description: A command of the `lathe` command line measures the business outcome: what it prints is the measure, as `lathe check` prints the coverage and the errors and warnings.
